name: cardiac_axis_projection
mechanism: Derives multi-lead amplitude scaling factors by projecting a random cardiac axis angle onto specific lead vectors, ensuring physiologically realistic inter-lead relationships.
code_snippet: scale_I = mag * np.cos(axis_angle); scale_II = mag * np.cos(axis_angle - np.pi/3)

name: consistent_intra_subject_twave_morphology
mechanism: Define T-wave amplitude, width, and alternans magnitude parameters outside the beat loop to maintain consistent waveform morphology across all beats for a given subject.

name: anchor_t_wave_termination
mechanism: Anchors the T-wave center at a fixed multiple of its standard deviation before the target QT end time to ensure consistent waveform termination across different morphologies.

name: stochastic_ecg_temporal_intervals
mechanism: Replaces hardcoded temporal offsets and widths for ECG wave components with stochastic variables to increase inter-subject physiological diversity.

name: increase_stochastic_parameter_variance
mechanism: Broadens the uniform distribution bounds for physiological and morphological parameters (such as cardiac axis, QRS amplitude, and interval offsets) to increase inter-subject diversity and reduce mode collapse.

name: randomize_q_s_wave_widths
mechanism: Replaces fixed constants with uniform random variables for Q and S wave widths to increase morphological diversity in the generated QRS complexes.
